summary: Tested 4 new features end to end, on the backend and the frontend. Backend: 16/16 pytest pass. Covered: bulk import with xlsx and csv (added/skipped rows with reasons, header names matched case-insensitively, BOM-prefixed csv, user types, executive rule for exec vs non-exec admin, must_change_password, 400 for missing columns, header-only sheet, bad file and >500 rows, 413 for files over 5MB, 403 for non-admins); probation keeps the given start_date with probation_end = start + 12 months; send_starter_nudge sends once (True, then False; notification created; starter_reminder_sent_at set; no email for @example.com); post_celebrations_to_teams with a monkeypatched post_to_teams (one post, and no post when celebrations is toggled off); the celebrations toggle is saved; resend-welcome for a support worker (new password works, old password and old session are rejected) and for office staff (temporary_password null); resend-welcome 404 and 403 errors. Frontend (375x667): import hint and upload button render; the CSV upload goes through the file chooser and the result dialog shows 2 added and 1 skipped; the resend confirm sheet leads to a toast and the temporary password dialog; the Integrations celebrations toggle shows when linked and its tap is saved (DB updated); Home and Library render. No deprecated Expo packages found in the reviewed files.

minor.issue: Some values are dropped with no warning. A birthday without a year (e.g. '15/03', '15 Mar') or a numeric Excel serial date (a cell not formatted as a date, or a CSV export of one) makes parse_day return None, so the field is simply left out. Reproduced: a CSV row with Birthday '15/03' was imported with no birthday and no warning.

Unknown User type values (e.g. 'Manager', 'Coordinator', a typo of 'Admin') silently become support_worker, and that person gets a password login. Consider skipping the row or adding a warning in the result.

The day's meta key (celebration_teams_<date>) is claimed before posting, and announce() swallows errors. A Teams outage around 8am means that day's celebrations are never posted and nothing retries. Acceptable, but worth noting.

Imported support workers whose start_date is more than 30 days ago (existing staff being migrated) get no default probation and no in-app welcome, because is_new_starter is False. Likely intended; confirm.

issues: The import result summary always says 'Everyone added has been emailed their welcome', even for @example.com addresses (skipped) or failed sends. Imported support workers can only get their temporary password by email, so the admin may wrongly think it was delivered.
The resend-welcome confirm button uses the red/danger style although the action is not destructive.
Each member card stacks up to 5 action buttons (Profile, Change type, Reset password, Resend welcome, Remove), so cards are very tall on mobile. Consider an overflow menu.

action_items: Import: support DD/MM birthdays without a year and numeric Excel serial dates, or list rows whose date or birthday couldn't be read in the result.
Import: skip or warn on unrecognised User type values instead of silently making them support_worker.
Team import dialog: base the 'emailed' message on real delivery (or warn when an email couldn't be sent), since imported support workers' temporary passwords go only by email.
Optional: use a non-danger variant for the 'Send email' confirm button.
critical_code_review_comments: users.import_users runs one db.users.find_one per row to check for duplicates (up to 500 queries). Fine at this size; could prefetch existing emails with a single $in query.
The 5MB check runs after file.read() has loaded the whole upload into memory. Acceptable.
seed_data_creation: None kept. All TEST users, notifications and sessions deleted; the teams_announcements integration removed (there was none before testing); no birthdays changed on seeded users; emp.test password untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Unit tests for the async helpers (send_starter_nudge, post_celebrations_to_teams) use a fresh AsyncIOMotorClient that is monkeypatched into core, routes.compliance, routes.celebrations and routes.teams (see run_with_db). Web import works via page.expect_file_chooser on team-import-button. The server clock reads Oct 2026.
